verifications.note: Jiangxi Provincial Investment Group bond tracking report (35pp): '天然气集团持有天然气管道公司54%股权，剩余46%股权由国家管网集团东部原油储运有限公司...持有' -- states the 54/46 split of the operating subsidiary (江西省天然气管道有限公司) that owns/operates the whole Phase I network. Names only the SYSTEM, not this trunk.

2022 CCXI credit-rating report for 江西省天然气集团有限公司 (independent publisher class -- rating agency vs. exchange bond disclosure): '天然气管道公司负责投资建设及运营承接川气东送气源的一期管网，为公司控股54%股' -- confirms the identical 54% stake and that this entity is responsible for the entire Phase I network (which includes this segment). System-level only.
2026 CCXI credit-rating report, same publisher a year later, reconfirms the same 54% stake and operating role for the Phase I network.

verifications.note: '承接川气东送工程气源的江西省天然气管网一期工程已建成管道870公里，主要建成九江一南昌、九江-沙河、九江-景德镇、南昌-丰城、高安-新余、丰城-抚州等6条干线和田南-上高支线' -- the same sentence NAMING 南昌-丰城 (this segment, listed as one of the six built Phase I trunks) states the Phase I network's gas source is 川气东送. Segment-level naming, not merely system-level, for this fact.

Independent 2008 news-wire source (different publisher/document class than the govt DRC plan): '管网气源先期是川气东送工程为江西输送的川气...一期工程建成后，实现向九江、南昌、新余、鹰潭、抚州、景德镇等城市供气' -- system-level statement (Nanchang named as a supplied city, not as this trunk's endpoint), but this is a genuinely uniform network-wide attribute: the entire Phase I grid (all 6 built trunks, including this one) draws from one common upstream source, so a system-level statement applies without qualification to every constituent segment (the 'one integrated network' exception).
